name: Exact served full-product catalogue acceptance after passive diagnostic repair
summary: Two actual hosted catalogue cases passed, zero skipped/flaky: every one of the 49 targets in each workspace state rendered a permitted destination or an explicit explanation, retained contextual Help/resume/review progress and rejected unexpected domain writes. Full committed RightRail unit suite passed 11/11. Four recorder assertions summarize these results; they are not four additional browser tests. No protected voice/manual/full affected/production shipment claim.

pair.scope: 31 root source dependencies and Portal source frozen; installed vendor dependencies and external email package shared; no full dependency graph immutability claim

servedArtifact.admission: WorkOS TEST accounts; isolated operator-api runtime; fixtures cleaned in finally; no interception/local-mode identity

assertions.evidence: Real browser assertions enumerate and verify all49 targets in each of two cases.
Each permitted destination preserves reviewed lesson ids and supports contextual Help plus resumed lesson focus; unavailable targets explain recovery.

Actual negative-write whitelist passed in both cases; no plugin-host refresh or local dev RPC writes. Same authenticated protected select-workspace response verified403 where navigation canceled a request.
Build identity verified before and after each journey;11 unit tests passed at exact root commit, including GET-only polling, no cloud requests and local-to-cloud interval teardown.
